name: waynestate/creed
description: The Wayne State app stack version policy as data, with a framework-free PHP reader.

scripts-descriptions.ci: The full CI gate: validate, tests, policy schema, Pint, handbook lint, handbook site freshness, agent-ready files, front page Table 2-1 freshness, front page counts, front page version-mention allowlist, PHPStan, audit, docs site freshness. Same command as CI on git.wayne.edu.
scripts-descriptions.site:handbook-check: Fail when site/handbook/ is stale against handbook/*.md.
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Rewrite the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml in site/ (Squire's agent-ready kit).
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail when the agent-ready files are stale, a page lacks its Markdown link, a prompt drifts from the docs, or the kit was edited here.
scripts-descriptions.site:versions: Write the front page's Table 2-1 dates and latest patches from policy/policy.json.
scripts-descriptions.site:versions-check: Fail when the front page's Table 2-1 is stale against policy/policy.json.
scripts-descriptions.site:tally: Write the front page's counts (the tally, the contents heading and rows, the practice and backlog counts) from BEST_PRACTICES.md.
scripts-descriptions.site:tally-check: Fail when a count on the front page is stale against BEST_PRACTICES.md.
scripts-descriptions.site:mentions: Rewrite site/version-mentions.txt from the front page's stack-project version mentions.
scripts-descriptions.site:mentions-check: Fail when a stack-project version mention on the front page is missing from site/version-mentions.txt, or a listed entry has no mention.
scripts-descriptions.docs: Rebuild site/docs/ from docs/ with the shared docs builder (Squire's kit).
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fail when site/docs/ is stale against docs/, a nav path has no page, or a page fails the builder's checks.
